Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262)
Order under section 3D

BY virtue of powers vested in me, by section 3D of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262), I, FaiszerMusthapha, Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, do by this Order amend the orders published inthe gazette Extraordinary No. 1928/26 of 21st August 2015 by amending boundaries, number of members and theconstituent parts of wards set out in second column in respect of Local Authorities set out in first column of firstschedule here to, as indicated in italics in second schedule of this order.
FAISZER MUSTHAPHAMinister of Provincial Councilsand Local Government.
17th February, 2017Colombo.
N.B. – Sinhala and Tamil versions are printed separately.
